# Semgrep Gotchas

> Known Semgrep and Opengrep patterns that cause silent failures or hard-to-debug errors, mostly around rule suppression.

## Entries

- [A paren-wrapped JSX match starts on the wrapper line, so nosemgrep goes above that line](nosemgrep-above-jsx-conditional-is-ignored.md): a `{cond && (` / `x ? (` / `return (` wrapped element is reported on the wrapper line, so `nosemgrep` belongs on or directly above it, not inside the parens; verify with `--json --disable-nosem` and watch for `PartialParsing` hiding the match. HIGH.
